{"notes":"Analysis 2026-11-25: real gap, wrong severity. P1 -> P2, and it wants splitting per profile.

Corrected count: 6 of 8 profiles lack a LintProfile impl, not 5 of 7. Present: BasicTlsProfile (lib.rs:247), BasicSmimeProfile (:447). Absent: Rfc5280Profile, BasicSmtpMtaProfile, BasicTlsClientProfile, BasicCodeSigningProfile, BasicTimeStampingProfile, BasicOcspResponderProfile.

Why it is not a P1: LintProfile is declared `pub trait LintProfile: Profile` with `fn lints(&self) -> &[Box<dyn Lint>];` and NO default body (pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:1809-1814). Profile does not require LintProfile. So a profile without the impl cannot be passed where LintProfile is expected and the caller gets a COMPILE ERROR, immediately, at the call site. There is no silent empty lint set and no wrong answer -- which is what P1 is for. This is a missing capability discovered at build time.

Why it wants splitting rather than one bead: each impl needs a considered lint selection, not a mechanical addition, and the existing two show the standard. BasicTlsProfile bundles SAN-with-dNSName-or-iPAddress (RFC 6125), serverAuth EKU presence, subscriber basicConstraints non-CA (5280 4.2.1.9), SAN-required-when-DN-empty (4.2.1.6), outer/inner signatureAlgorithm match (4.1) and the serial-length cap (4.1.2.2). The analogues differ per profile: clientAuth EKU for BasicTlsClientProfile, codeSigning for BasicCodeSigningProfile, the RFC 3161 2.3 sole-and-critical timeStamping EKU for BasicTimeStampingProfile (already enforced inside verify_time_stamper, so the lint and the verifier must agree), OCSPSigning for BasicOcspResponderProfile, and the RFC 8461/8689 shapes for BasicSmtpMtaProfile. Rfc5280Profile is the odd one: its lint set is the pure 5280 baseline, i.e. the intersection of the others.

Design note confirmed, not a defect: CA/B Forum overlay lints (SHA-1 prohibition, RSA min key size, SC-081 validity caps) are deliberately NOT in these impls -- they live on pkix_profiles_cabf::WebPkiProfile and SmimeProfile. So the baseline impls stay RFC-only by intent, and any new impl must respect that split.","priority":2}
